A Night at the Zoo
Narrator Sarah and Jim are at the zoo. It is night.
Jim Sarah! I see something!
Sarah What is it, Jim?
Jim I don’t know.
Sarah It’s an elephant!
Jim It isn’t an elephant. It’s little.
Sarah It’s a duck!
Jim It isn’t a duck. It has a long tail.
Sarah It’s a mouse!
Jim No! It’s a monkey! And it’s under an umbrella!

18Units 1 & 2 — Get Ready to Speak استعد للتحدث

📖 من الكتاب
SPEAKING GOAL: Give an Introduction

An introduction tells about you. It tells your name. It tells where you live. It gives other information, too.

التعريف بالنفس: اسمك، وعمرك، وأين تعيش، ومعلومات أخرى عنك.

A — Read and listen to the introduction. Underline I and my.

📖 من الكتاب
🔊 An introductionTrack 22
00:00 / 00:00
📝 Listening Script — Track 22صفحة 18 · تمرين A
Page 18, get ready to speak. A, read and listen to the introduction. Underline, I and my. Hello, my name is Jin Gu Kim. I am eight years old. I live in Seoul. It is a city in South Korea. I like cats.
Jin-Goo’s introduction
Hello! My name is Jin-Goo Kim. I am 8 years old. I live in Seoul. It is a city in South Korea. I like cats.
💬 Speaking Tip
  • Use I and my in your introduction.
